title: Anthropic opens at $111.50 per share in record IPO: Live updates (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Anthropic opens at $111.50 per share in record IPO: Live updates … Anthropic opened at $111.50 per share in the artificial intelligence lab's Nasdaq debut on Thursday after the company completed the biggest initial public offering on record. — The stock will trade under the ticker “ANT” …
contentText:

Anthropic opens at $111.50 per share in record IPO: Live updates … Anthropic opened at $111.50 per share in the artificial intelligence lab's Nasdaq debut on Thursday after the company completed the biggest initial public offering on record.  —  The stock will trade under the ticker “ANT” …
